name: kindling
source:
inspired by "Are You Afraid of the Dark" and "GitS: SAC"

A group of friends gather every Halloween to tell scary tales. One new member doesn't know what he's in for. One member cannot attend, but is there in spirit.

[From [url=https://mykanthrope.itch.io/kindling]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
灵感来自《你害怕黑暗吗？》和《攻壳机动队：STAND ALONE COMPLEX》。

一群朋友每年万圣节都会聚在一起讲鬼故事。一位新成员不知道自己即将面对什么；另有一位成员无法到场，却会以另一种方式陪伴大家。

[引自[url=https://mykanthrope.itch.io/kindling]Itch.io[/url]]
